headline: The first Pakistan Halal Forum 2026 concluded in Karachi on Saturday, with the Pakistan Halal Authority saying it aims to lift halal exports to $40-50 billion a year; organisers say Pakistan has less than 1% share of the global halal economy, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Global halal economy mein Pakistan ka hissa 1% se kam.

caption:
Halal exports ko $40-50 billion saalana tak le jane ka hadaf!
Arab News ke mutabiq Karachi mein pehla Pakistan Halal Forum 2026 Saturday ko khatam hua. Pakistan Halal Authority ke mutabiq maqsad raw material ke bajaye certified value-added products bech kar halal exports ko $40-50 billion saalana tak le jana hai, jab ke organisers ke mutabiq global halal economy mein Pakistan ka hissa abhi 1% se kam hai.
Kya Pakistan halal hub ban sakta hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
